findings.message: Promised smoke test is unverified: it is a manual step (install the build, reload the window, inspect ~/.insrc/chat-sessions and state.vscdb) with no automated counterpart in the changed set, and no build record is available to show it was performed. Not reported as a missing automated test; the migration and wiring it exercises are covered by the unit and integration tests, which pass.
findings.expectationRef: after installing the build and reloading the window, the three existing chats open with their history, ~/.insrc/chat-sessions holds a head and a rows file for each, and the extension's value in state.vscdb no longer holds the sessions

findings.message: Caveat on the grounding, not a coverage gap: testsReaching is empty for every production symbol in session-file-store.ts, session-store.ts and extension.ts (e.g. createFileChatSessionStore, migrateChatSessionsFromMemento, save, get, evictBeyondCap, migrateOne) because the graph has no edges from the anonymous node:test callbacks. I therefore judged coverage by running the suite instead of raising HIGH findings from hollow edges: the five changed test files ran 202 tests, 202 pass, 0 fail, 0 skipped, and all 22 promised unit and integration tests are present under their exact promised titles (session-file-store.test.ts, session-file-store.integration.test.ts, session-store.test.ts:327, extension-chat-wiring.test.ts:260, chat-panel.test.ts:3694).

Duplication: the file store defines its own `draft(provider)` session factory alongside the one in the memento store, with the same signature. If the draft shape (default fields, id/time stamping) changes in one, the other can drift. Judged from signatures only — bodies were not inspected, so this is an observation, not a confirmed overlap.

Duplication: the test helpers `say` and `texts` are redefined identically to those in the unit test file, even though a shared test-support module (fake-session-fs.ts) already exists in the same folder. Test-only, no production risk.

Duplication: a second `diskRows` helper that reads a session's rows file from disk and parses it line by line, overlapping the one in the integration test. Both encode the on-disk rows format, so a format change needs two test edits. Test-only.
